item.title: GitTube weekly digest: week 45, 2026 (2–8 Nov 2026)
item.description:
The best of GitHub this week (2–8 Nov 2026), picked from GitTube's lanes. This entry is refreshed daily until the week ends.

Rising fastest

  1. storytold/craft-anything (Rust) ★ 13,683, +3,971 this day: Craft Anything: understand how any software works, and craft your own.
  2. KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop (TypeScript) ★ 3,005, +1,186 this day: 让你的命令行 Agent 在后台自己接活、自己跟进到底；平时不烦你，遇到拿不准的事才发卡片找你拍板。
  3. deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype (TypeScript) ★ 19,133, +1,127 this day: Towards a More Autonomous Agent System
  4. Gathin23/cleanyourtv (Python) ★ 52,288, +643 this day: Debloat any Android or Google TV over Wi-Fi and get an Apple TV-style home.
  5. patch-gg/pixelfx (JavaScript) ★ 5,048, +615 this day: 244 pixel art effects, every one a small piece of code. Plus a Claude Code skill to make your own.

Today

  • worldonlyu/Google_AI_Pro_2Year_ZeroCost_Auto (Python) ★ 1,443: Google_AI_Pro_2Year_ZeroCost_Auto
  • dragonwolfshovel/youtube-uploader (Python) ★ 426: Automated YouTube video uploader with batch processing, thumbnail support, and scheduled publishing. Uses official YouTube Data API v3. Open
  • TagPhaseArcade/tiktok-uploader (Python) ★ 425: Automated TikTok video uploader with batch processing, scheduling, and hashtag management. Local session-based auth. Open-source and cross-p

This week

  • Verlintas/NOIR (Kotlin) ★ 2,313: 手机隐私审计：用 adb 扫出 Android 应用的权限、上报端点与数据流向，并给出可回滚的处置。Desktop Android leak audit: permissions, endpoints, data flows, reversible fixes.
  • elvarofficial/teardown (JavaScript) ★ 2,024: A Claude Code skill that turns any machine into a 3D simulator you can take apart
  • caru-ini/stack-diagram (TypeScript) ★ 1,815: Agent skill: describe your stack in a sentence, get an architecture diagram with official logos

Python

  • deepseek-ai/DeepInfer (Python) ★ 25,436: DeepInfer: High-performance, large-scale inference framework for DeepSeek models
  • seedds/nxnative (Python) ★ 12,308: Switch games running natively on iPhone, iPad and Mac: an NSP folder becomes an unsigned IPA (NSO rewriter, Horizon HLE host, NVN→Metal)
  • xiaoyang111222/cn-math-taxonomy (Python) ★ 6,711: 数学（小学到高中）、英语（三年级到高中）、初中物理的知识图谱：1644 个知识点、2403 条先修边、6723 道题，对齐课标，附自适应前置诊断。

Rust

  • storytold/wordcraft (Rust) ★ 17,344: An open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Microsoft Word in pure Rust
  • tangency-labs/solidcraft (Rust) ★ 13,927: SolidCraft: an open-source parametric 3D CAD application built in pure Rust. Desktop, web, and automation through MCP.
  • storytold/cadcraft (Rust) ★ 7,672: CADCraft: computer-aided design and drafting — an open-source, clean-room AutoCAD-style app in pure Rust

Telecom

  • absmach/magistrala (Go) ★ 2,659: IoT Platform Framework
  • Community-VyProjects/VyManager (TypeScript) ★ 494: Multi-tenant network management platform to configure, deploy, and monitor VyOS instances across multiple sites.
  • praetorian-inc/nerva (Go) ★ 376: Fast service fingerprinting CLI for 170+ protocols (TCP/UDP/SCTP) - built by Praetorian

5G

  • taubyte/tau (Go) ★ 5,185: Fullstack Workspace for Humans & Machines
  • open5gs/open5gs (C) ★ 2,803: Open5GS is a C-language Open Source implementation for 5G Core and EPC, i.e. the core network of LTE/NR network (Release-19)
  • free5gc/free5gc (Go) ★ 2,370: Open source 5G core network based on 3GPP R17
